replication.target_description: Study 3: Indian MTurk participants; ethical versus unethical passage typed with punctuation restored; generic product descriptions; independent-samples t test of mean desirability of cleansing items.

n.sample_role: Indian MTurk participants in the two-group cleansing-desirability analysis; analytic N cannot be established consistently.
n.exclusions: 286 recruited; 17 excluded for incomplete questionnaires. These counts do not reconcile with the printed t-test degrees of freedom, 260; no analytic N printed.
n.quote: Seventeen participants were excluded from analyses for failure to complete the questionnaires.

reported_success.quote: In Study 3 we failed to find a relationship between physical and moral purity in an Indian sample

notes: Requested test statistic extracted for overall cleansing desirability. Analytic n left null: recruitment/exclusion counts conflict with the reported test degrees of freedom.
